description: Allow WRITE to /anything/finance/* only to principals who hold BOTH 'admin' and 'finance'. Demonstrates a multi-condition ABAC rule combining a resource attribute (path REGEX) with a principal attribute (role CONTAINS_ALL). carol (admin+finance) is granted; alice (admin only) is denied. The /anything/finance/ prefix uses httpbin's catch-all endpoint, which stands in for a real finance service's routes.
